gloss: rescue squad; ambulance crew; emergency response team

definitions.gloss: rescue squad; ambulance crew; emergency response team
definitions.explanation: A team of emergency medical personnel who respond to calls and provide prehospital care.

examples.japanese: {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}がすぐに{来|き}た。
examples.english: The rescue squad arrived right away.

examples.japanese: {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}が{患者|かんじゃ}を{病院|びょういん}に{搬送|はんそう}した。
examples.english: The ambulance crew transported the patient to the hospital.

examples.japanese: {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}の{隊員|たいいん}が{現場|げんば}で{応急処置|おうきゅうしょち}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: A member of the rescue squad administered first aid at the scene.

notes:
In Japan, {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい} crews are part of the fire department ({消防署|しょうぼうしょ}), not a separate ambulance service. They are dispatched by calling 119, the emergency number for both fire and ambulance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {救急隊員|きゅうきゅうたいいん} — rescue squad member; paramedic
- {救急車|きゅうきゅうしゃ} — ambulance
- {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}が{出動|しゅつどう}する — the rescue squad deploys
- {救急隊|きゅうきゅうたい}に{引|ひ}き{渡|わた}す — to hand over to the rescue squad

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {救助隊|きゅうじょたい} — rescue team (focused on rescuing people from danger, such as collapsed buildings)
- {消防隊|しょうぼうたい} — firefighting team (focused on extinguishing fires)
